What saves when, on Setup pages

Every picture is the real platform, photographed, with the new parts drawn into the live page. Parts marked To check are new in this round. The rest you have already agreed.

The three rules

Clicks save themselves
Switches, ticks and the cells of Roles & access. Each click is saved at once and says Saved right where you clicked. Turning something on never asks. Turning something down or off asks first, just under it.
Typing waits for Save
Words, numbers and dates. Save and Discard sit under the area, with an amber line naming what is waiting. When that row is out of sight it sticks to the bottom of the window. Leaving the page with something unsaved asks first.
Colours wait for Apply
Nothing on the page changes until Apply. Undo shows for about ten seconds after. Reset to the shipped palette stays.

1 · A click that gives more: saved on the spot To check

Roles & access. You let Contributors change their own plan. It is saved straight away, and Saved shows beside the cell for a moment. No Save button anywhere.

2 · A click that takes away: asked first, under the row To check

You press the eye on Owner's own reporting, which would take their pen away. Nothing changes yet. A gold line opens under the row and says what happens, to how many people: Change it or Keep as it was.

3 · Typing: the Save row sticks to the bottom when it is out of sight To check

The shape screen. You type Vision in place of Winning Aspiration on the top level. The box is outlined. The Save row belongs at the foot of this panel, which is far below, so it sticks to the bottom of the window until you save or discard.

4 · Leaving with something typed and unsaved Agreed

You press another page on the left. The same place at the bottom now asks: Save and continue, Discard changes or Keep editing.

5 · End in Mind, with its own tick To check

On the shape screen, a row under Winning Aspiration with a tick, like the other parts. Ticking it is a click, so it saves itself. Unticking asks first, because it hides the line everywhere.

LayerHas End in Mind?Starts
Top levelYesTicked
DivisionsYesTicked
Business unitsYesTicked
Supporting functionsNo: a function has no Winning AspirationNot shown
CapabilitiesNo: their first section is only what it is and its North StarNot shown

It sits inside the Winning Aspiration, so it is greyed and off on any layer where the aspiration is unticked. It starts ticked because it is an optional line that only shows once somebody writes it, so ticking it never adds a Missing anywhere. That also keeps every client's screen as it is today.

6 · Where End in Mind shows when ticked To check

Mobile's Strategy page, Foundation, under the Winning Aspiration. The same line goes on the temple picture at the top level and on the "What we are aiming at" slide in the presentations. Unticked, it leaves all three, and the words are kept.

7 · Colours Agreed

Pick, and only the colour box changes. Apply, and the page takes it, with Undo for a few seconds. The same for the bands' colours.
